clips.title: The story
paras: Elder Obsidian is an ancestral earthen spirit who manifests at the Sepulcher in Silverpine Forest during the annual Lunar Festival. Appearing among the graves claimed by the Forsaken, he offers the wisdom and blessings of the ancient world to travelers honoring the festival.

Standing amid the somber tombs of the Sepulcher, Elder Obsidian provides a striking contrast to Silverpine Forest's gloomy expanse. As an ethereal earthen elder, his spirit manifests during the Lunar Festival to celebrate the ancient heritage of Azeroth. While the surrounding crypts are held by the Forsaken and menaced by feral worgen, Obsidian greets wayfarers of all allegiances in peace, bestowing Coin of Ancestry and ancient blessings upon those who take the time to seek out his wisdom.
